old: "In B2 Hungarian, whenever a main clause expresses purpose ('in order that'), public appeals ('demanded that'), or institutional precaution ('ensured that'), the subordinate clause introduced by hogy requires the subjunctive/imperative mood (-j- suffix: épüljön, fejlődjön, megszólaljon). Notice how the verbal prefix stays attached in positive purpose clauses (hogy megszólalhasson), whereas in negative clauses with ne or nehogy the prefix separates or follows the negative particle."
new: "Recap: you know hogy + subjunctive (-jon/-jen) from B1 Unit 5, reported demands from B1 Unit 53 and indirect commands with hogy from B2 Unit 7; here they carry a theatre history. In B2 Hungarian, whenever a main clause expresses purpose ('in order that'), public appeals ('demanded that'), or institutional precaution ('ensured that'), the subordinate clause introduced by hogy requires the subjunctive/imperative mood (-j- suffix: épüljön, fejlődjön, megszólaljon). Notice how the verbal prefix stays attached when nothing stands in focus right before the verb (hogy megszólaljon), but follows the verb when a focused word precedes it (hogy a nemzet teremtse meg); in negative clauses with ne or nehogy the prefix separates or follows the negative particle."
